title: Stem Cell Transplantation
description: CMS National Coverage Determination for Allogeneic and Autologous Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation (HSCT) (NCD 110.23).

change_log.author: CMS MCD Coverage API
change_log.summary: Transcribed from CMS NCD 110.23 via official Coverage API.

criteria.name: Diagnosis of Eligible Hematologic Malignancy or Aplastic Anemia
criteria.description: Treatment of leukemia, leukemia in remission, aplastic anemia, myelodysplastic syndrome (MDS), or severe combined immunodeficiency disease.
criteria.clinical_intent: Confirm diagnosis of covered hematologic malignancy or marrow failure
criteria.required_temporal_window: Clinical progress note or diagnostic report
criteria.source_text_excerpt: treatment of leukemia, leukemia in remission, or aplastic anemia when it is reasonable and necessary,&lt

criteria.name: Risk Stratification Score (IPSS Intermediate-2 or High for MDS)
criteria.description: For myelodysplastic syndrome, documentation of risk score >= 1.5 (Intermediate-2 or High) using the International Prognostic Scoring System (IPSS).
criteria.clinical_intent: Validated prognostic risk threshold for stem cell transplant in MDS
criteria.required_temporal_window: Clinical progress note or diagnostic report

criteria.name: Standard Organ Function Workup and Suitable Donor Match
criteria.description: Adequate organ function workup (cardiac, pulmonary, hepatic, renal) and human leukocyte antigen (HLA) matched donor.
criteria.clinical_intent: Candidate organ reserve and histocompatibility suitability
criteria.required_temporal_window: Clinical progress note or diagnostic report
